text:
Noelle (People Ops): idea — small physical "appreciation stamp" cards we can leave on desks + mail to remote folks the week of Jul 14. low-cost, fun, pairs with digital shoutouts. thoughts? :sparkles:
Priya (HR Ops): love it, feels tangible. what's the per-person budget? any vendor recs?
Jamie (Events): can design a postcard-sized card with a foil stamp or sticker. foil ups the cost but looks premium. example vendor: MintPaper Co. (they did our picnic invites).
Marta (Global Ops): we need to plan for EU fulfilment — printers that can drop-ship to EU/UK to avoid customs headaches. also consider language on the card (EN only ok?).
Ben (Procurement): ballpark pricing: 500 cards w/ basic gloss = ~$420 incl shipping in US. foil/spot UV bump = +$250. I'll ping MintPaper for a quote and lead time (usually 7–10 business days).
Noelle (People Ops): thanks Ben. target audience ~380 employees + 30 contractors = 410. let's budget for 450 to have extras. Priya — any compliance/tax flags on sending small gifts to contractors in certain countries?
Priya (HR Ops): small token under $50 usually fine but must log distribution. I'll run a quick check for AU/CA contractors. also recommend an opt-out survey for folks who don't want physical mail.
hr-bot: Reminder: for any physical gifts, please fill the "Gifts & Distribution" sheet in People Ops shared drive. Link: https://drive.company/gifts
Jamie (Events): mock copy idea: "A tiny thanks — drop this card on someone's desk or mail it to brighten their week." Backside: a mini prompt for shoutouts and a QR to post to #kudos.
Marta (Global Ops): QR linking to the kudos thread is smart. For EU drop-ships we should supply prefilled addresses CSV to vendor. Ben — can you confirm the CSV format they need?
Ben (Procurement): MintPaper asked for: ```name,address_line1,address_line2,city,postal,country``` I'll include email for tracking.
Noelle (People Ops): timeline: finalize design by Jun 30, order by Jul 3, deliveries Jul 14–18. Can everyone commit? I'll make a short checklist and a sign-up for desk drop volunteers.
Priya (HR Ops): I'll scope opt-out and contractor checks by Jun 25. Also will add a short blurb for managers to avoid surprises in non-office locations.
Jamie (Events): I'll do two design options and post in #design-review tomorrow. Prefer to keep copy concise.
Marta (Global Ops): I'll map out distribution buckets: US offices / EU direct-ship / APAC consolidated (ship to SG hub). Need lead times per region.
Ben (Procurement): getting vendor quote today, will share PO template. Shipping estimate: US ground 3–5 days, EU DHL 5–7 days, APAC consolidated ~10 days.
Noelle (People Ops): action items: (1) Jamie design (2) Ben vendor quote + PO (3) Priya compliance opt-out + contractor checks (4) Marta regional plan + address CSV template. I'll create a tiny Trello card and assign. Anyone else to loop in?
Priya (HR Ops): maybe loop in Legal briefly for EU shipping terms.
Jamie (Events): looping in @design to review by EOD tomorrow.
Marta (Global Ops): adding a note — if someone is remote and wants no mail, we'll have a digital badge alternative they can claim via the QR.
Noelle (People Ops): perfect. thanks team! I'll post a quick RSVP + volunteer form and drop the Trello link here when ready. :party_parrot:
